messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take amlodipine exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Amlodipine is usually taken once per day.
Take the medicine at the same time each day, with or without food.
Shake the oral suspension (liquid). Measure a dose with the supplied measuring device (not a kitchen spoon).
Amlodipine for oral solution (Sdamlo) comes as a powder that you must mix with water to make a liquid (solution) before taking or giving it. Throw away Sdamlo if you do not take or give it within 60 minutes of mixing and get a new bottle. Do not store mixed Sdamlo.
Your blood pressure will need to be checked often.
If you have high blood pressure, keep using amlodipine even if you feel well. High blood pressure often has no symptoms.
Do not change your doses or stop taking any of your medications without your doctor's advice.
Your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, and blood tests.
Triplet: ["Amlodipine", "has treatment component", "diet"]

The relation 'has treatment component' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's treatment regimen includes the specified intervention or lifestyle change as part of the overall management plan.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in combination with': The subject drug is used together with the other treatment or lifestyle measure specified by the object entity.
C. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
D. 'has recommended treatment for severe hypoglycemia': The subject drug is associated with the use of the specified medical intervention to manage severe hypoglycemia.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
